question.text: Let <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>V</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cos</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sec</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfenced><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cos</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>θ</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>s</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>c</mi></mrow></mrow><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mfenced><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></math>, where <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></math> are unit vectors and the angle between <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></math> is <math><msup><mrow><mn>60</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msup></math>, then the minimum value of <math><msup><mrow><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>V</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msup></math> is equal to

solution.text:
V→2=cos⁡θ+sec⁡θa^+cos⁡θ-sec⁡θb^2
=cos⁡θ+sec⁡θ2+cos⁡θ-sec⁡θ2+(cos⁡θ-sec⁡θ)(cos⁡θ+sec⁡θ)
=3cos2⁡θ+sec2⁡θ≥23
⇒ least value of V→2=23
⇒ least value of V→4=12
